TurboRegs replaces this fragmented process with a structured, intelligent system that brings speed, accuracy, and transparency to regulatory readiness.

The platform digitizes regulatory intake, document collection, and submission workflows while enforcing completeness and consistency across studies. Using AI, TurboRegs identifies missing or outdated documents, validates required elements, and ensures submissions are IRB-ready the first time.

With TurboRegs, sponsors, CROs, and research sites can:
• Standardize regulatory packets across studies and investigators
• Reduce back-and-forth caused by incomplete submissions
• Gain real-time visibility into submission status and readiness
• Maintain a centralized, audit-ready regulatory document source
• Scale regulatory operations across portfolios and site networks

Rather than serving as another eReg repository, TurboRegs acts as a regulatory orchestration engine—turning regulatory data into structured assets and workflows that keep studies moving.

TurboRegs sets the regulatory cadence of clinical trials—eliminating startup drag and accelerating IRB readiness.
